title: Social Norms in Cinema: A Cross-Cultural Analysis of Shame, Pride and Prejudice
findings: The paper does not analyze religion or faith; therefore, there are no specific findings on this topic. The focus is on cross-cultural differences between the USA and India (individualism vs. collectivism) regarding the social emotions of shame and pride.
